validity.recommendation: sheet wrong (incomplete) — set StartYear1=2007. The row is genuinely missing a start year despite Status=operating; independent research finds a verifiable startup year, so the gap should be filled rather than left blank.
validity.researcher_notes: This is the Qasr field's export line (24in diameter, matching sheet Diameter=24) carrying gas/condensate from the Qasr gas-condensate field (Matruh, Western Desert) to the Shams manifold en route to the Salam gas plant, operated under Khalda Petroleum Co (Apache/EGPC JV; sheet Owner=General Petroleum Co / Parent=EGPC is consistent with the EGPC side of that JV). Egypt Oil & Gas's 'Qasr Gas Development Project' feature (a project-phase summary, likely drawn from an Apache/Khalda/Petrojet presentation) breaks the Qasr field development into Phase I Early production (started 2005, 150 MMcfd, $139M) and Phase I Permanent production (started 2007, 350 MMcfd, $131M) -- this 350 MMcfd figure is an EXACT match to the sheet's own Capacity=350.00 MMcf/d, which is strong circumstantial confirmation that this GEM row corresponds to that 2007 permanent-production milestone (i.e., the export pipeline reaching its planned throughput). Apache Corp's FY2007 10-K (SEC EDGAR, read but NOT cited below -- url_verifier returned HTTP 403 on sec.gov, likely a bot-blocking/User-Agent issue, so it fails the citation gate) independently corroborates the general timeline: Qasr had 'a full year of production' by 2006, Khalda gas volumes grew steadily through 2006-2008, and a SEPARATE, later compression/expansion project (approved 2006, construction started 2007, two new 100 MMcf/d trains completing late 2008) is clearly distinguished from this initial permanent-production buildout -- consistent with, and not contradicting, a 2007 startup for this specific line. Could not find a second fully independent, citable source giving the same explicit '2007' + '350 MMcfd' combination (most other retrievable sources on Qasr/Salam/Shams infrastructure are either the same egyptoil-gas.com domain from a different angle, wikidot.com (excluded per standing rules), or cover only the pre-2003/2005 early-appraisal period or the unrelated 2012-2015 compression project). Tier is therefore medium: one strong, specific, verified source plus consistent (but non-specific) corroboration from an independent SEC filing that could not itself be cited due to a verifier/access failure. Searched Arabic-language sources (site: petro-news.com, attaqa.net, gasreg.org.eg) for a 'khط أنابيب قصر شمس' angle; nothing pipeline-specific surfaced beyond general Western Desert gas-network coverage, so no Arabic source is included here.
